families.careful: Is it careful with its money?

edge.window: 2021-01 to 2026-08, 68 months, rebalanced each month end
edge.source: SPDR SPY and iShares AGG adjusted monthly closes, FRED TB3MS

personas.client: buys what is getting attention: stocks with big recent moves, heavy trading and fresh news.
wants a chance at a big win: cheap, volatile stocks whose returns can jump a long way.
follows trends: stocks that have risen strongly and steadily over the past year.
buys the dip: stocks that have fallen recently and look oversold.
wants steady income: stable, profitable companies that pay and grow dividends.
buys what they know: large, well-established companies.

agents.name: Rules reader
agents.does: Reads the finals rules and quotes every limit word for word
facts: every one, with its source line

agents.name: Triage
agents.does: Sorts company filings into routine, good, bad and distress

agents.name: Analyst
agents.does: Reads a stock's month with names, tickers and dates hidden

agents.name: Devil's advocate
agents.does: Attacks the final book, and code checks every claim

agents.name: Memo writer
agents.does: Writes the PM memo, and every number in it is checked

agents.name: Explainer
agents.does: Says why the book holds a name, from the facts it was shown

agents.name: Risk desk
agents.does: Proposes shrinking a position at a risky moment from a card with no name, ticker or date. A devil's advocate argues back
facts: a fixed rule and 100 random desks
No help, so the fund runs without it
